memories.content: The caller is assigned to phone Dr. Renata Sousa for a first-time donation ask. They have a script and a list of alumni to call, and they will make the call during the evening shift.

Ashvale University has an annual fund that contacts alumni for donations. The caller will phone Renata at some point during the month. Renata can be reached at her phone number on file. The call may go to voicemail or be answered. If answered, the caller will make a first-time ask for a pledge. A pledge is a commitment to donate a specific amount by a future date, not an immediate payment.
